scripts.dev:clean: powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Test-Path .next-dev) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath .next-dev -Recurse -Force }"; pnpm exec next dev -p 3000
scripts.preview:cloudflare: pnpm exec opennextjs-cloudflare build && pnpm exec opennextjs-cloudflare preview
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: pnpm exec opennextjs-cloudflare build && pnpm exec opennextjs-cloudflare deploy
scripts.cf-typegen: pnpm exec wrangler types --env-interface CloudflareEnv cloudflare-env.d.ts
